content: Origin: #29 audit. polaris-backend/src/labeler/signer/passphrase_sealed.rs carries 6× `#[allow(deprecated, reason = "aes-gcm 0.10 internal generic-array 0.x; bump with aes-gcm 0.11 stable")]` at GenericArray::from_slice call sites. As of 2026-05-14 crates.io shows only aes-gcm 0.11.0-rc.3. When 0.11.0 ships stable: bump in [workspace.dependencies], remove the 6 allow blocks. Coordinates with proto-blue, secrecy, k256 because they share generic-array via the AEAD ecosystem — workspace-coordination event.
